A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constsntine. Mint is uncertain, 330-335, Reece period 17. Obverse shows laureate bust right. Obverse legend reads (CONSTANT)[...]. Reverse shows two soldiers, two standards. Reverse legend reads [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Reverse fields and exergue reads: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.37g, diameter is 17.86mm
